rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible ICM, but it overstates confidence in TE quality and zona thinning from a single image; calling the image clearly concordant with 3AA is somewhat stronger than the visual evidence alone supports.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, tubal factor diagnosis, BMI, endometrium, prior biochemical pregnancy, and semen parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logical and well-structured, with probability estimates broadly matching the case; minor issues include speculative links (e.g., sedentary lifestyle, residual smoking effects, immune/thrombophilia discussion after one biochemical pregnancy).

SET recommendation and general prognosis are guideline-consistent, but suggesting ERA, immune testing, thrombophilia workup, and MTHFR after limited failure history is more aggressive than evidence-based guideline standards.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, monitoring, and contingency planning, though some suggested future investigations are not well-prioritized for this specific history.
